environment.description: Same Go application deployed behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private subnet with no internet gateway. The NLB target group has a listener on port 443 with TLS termination. Access is restricted via VPC security group sg-internal-only which permits inbound traffic exclusively from three internal CIDR ranges: 10.2.0.0/16 (service mesh sidecar proxies), 172.16.4.0/22 (CI/CD runners for health checks), and 192.168.100.0/24 (SRE bastion hosts). The NLB itself has no public-facing ENI. Additionally, the VPC has no NAT gateway or internet gateway attached, and the subnet route table contains only local VPC routes (no 0.0.0.0/0 route). DNS resolution for the NLB endpoint is only available via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the VPC. There is no VPC peering or Transit Gateway attachment to any VPC that has internet connectivity.

config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone only, no public DNS record
